title: "Make the light warmer" on a delivered image is a revise_job, started without a question

prompts.note: Sent right after the agent delivered an image job in the same session.

prompts.text: Make the light a bit warmer.
prompts.note: Same setup: an image job was just delivered.

expected_output: The agent calls revise_job on the delivered job with the change as the instruction (warmer light, everything else kept) and a new requestId, without quote, quotedCredits or a question. If the call times out it retries with the same requestId. It follows get_job, delivers the new version and says it kept everything else.
required_facts: revise_job on the delivered job; no new generate_* call
A timeout retry reuses the same requestId
The closing line offers 2-3 changes as a statement
safety_behavior: One paid revision; never a second one with a new requestId.

fixture.review_account: Buildary review account with a finished image job delivered earlier in the session

grading_criteria: PASS if one revise_job starts in turn 0 with no question, every paid call shares one requestId, and no generate_* call is made. FAIL on a question, a new generation, or a second revise_job with a new requestId.
